note: Nothing crosses the E-W avenue at the expected x 8957 (continuous block 35 to the south, White's Subdiv'n to the north). The nearest side street is Greenlawn Ave, which ends in a T at the E-W avenue about 330 px east. LYONS EST.' and large spaced 'J O N A T H A N' estate lettering appear to the SE.
Tunnell St runs ESE from the subdivision boundary at about x 4215 and ends in a T at Beresford Ave. Its position matches the expected point, so it is taken to be today's Braxton Campbell Court.

Rammelsberg St is present, running NW-SE with its NW end at about (4100,4450). Tunnell St (taken to be Braxton Campbell Ct, see 69_035) ends at the orange boundary at about (4215,4100) and does not reach Rammelsberg. At the expected point (4274,4577) the north side of Rammelsberg is solid lots: Sam Beresford lot 2 and the Cincinnati Model Homes block 58. The dashed line running south from Tunnell's west end is a 12-inch sewer, not a street.

Only 'AVE.' is printed on this stretch of the N-S avenue. Its 3200 house numbers continue from Beresford Ave further north, so it is the plate's Beresford Ave, taken as today's Blair Ave. It ends in a T at Gilbert Ave. Gilbert's south half is cut off by the plate edge, so the Gilbert centreline is estimated (about at the car tracks).
Same crossing as 69_037. The N-S avenue ('AVE.', 3200 numbers, continuation of Beresford Ave) meets Gilbert Ave in a T. Gilbert's south half is cut by the plate edge.

It meets Gilbert Ave about 45 px from the expected point and continues south on a plate-edge tab (x 6100-6200), so it is a cross. Gilbert's south side is at the plate edge. Taken as the predecessor of Victory Parkway by position only.
